title: From Preferences to Prejudice: The Role of Alignment Tuning in Shaping Social Bias in Video Diffusion Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ratio of male to female representations in generated videos across various events/actions using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to classify gender in sampled frames, and calculating a Proportion Bias Score for Gender (PBS_G) to quantify gender skew.

Measuring the demographic distribution of inferred ethnic groups in generated videos prompted with neutral descriptors, using VLMs for frame-wise classification, and evaluating over/underrepresentation using Representation Deviation Scores (RDS_e) and Simpson's Diversity Index (SDI).
